cd /tmp/regextest && cat > test2.py << 'EOF'
import re, time

with open("/app/regex.txt") as f:
    pattern = f.read().strip()

cases = [
    # leading-zero octets
    ("10.0.0.01 2024-01-15", []),                       # 01 has leading zero -> no IP
    ("01.0.0.1 2024-01-15", []),                        # leading zero
    ("10.0.0.123 2024-01-15", ["2024-01-15"]),          # 123 ok
    # dot adjacency on IP (spec: only alnum matters)
    ("1.2.3.4.5 2024-01-15", ["2024-01-15"]),           # '1.2.3.4' followed by '.' -> valid per spec
    ("2024-01-15 1.2.3.4.", ["2024-01-15"]),
    # date adjacent to ip directly
    ("10.0.0.12024-01-15", []),                         # ip octet glued to date -> both invalid
    # multiple dates, last one glued (invalid), second last valid
    ("10.0.0.1 2024-01-01 2024-01-02x", ["2024-01-01"]),
    # ip at very start / end
    ("10.0.0.12024-01-15 tail", []),
    ("2024-01-15 10.0.0.1", ["2024-01-15"]),
    # underscore is NOT alphanumeric -> allowed by spec
    ("_2024-01-15 10.0.0.1", ["2024-01-15"]),
    ("2024-01-15_ 10.0.0.1", ["2024-01-15"]),
    # unicode letter adjacent -> not in [A-Za-z0-9] -> allowed by spec
    ("\u00e92024-01-15 10.0.0.1", ["2024-01-15"]),
    # feb 29 always valid
    ("1900-02-29 1.2.3.4", ["1900-02-29"]),
    ("2023-02-29 1.2.3.4", ["2023-02-29"]),
    # month/day combos
    ("10.0.0.1 2024-12-31", ["2024-12-31"]),
    ("10.0.0.1 2024-10-31", ["2024-10-31"]),
    ("10.0.0.1 2024-11-30", ["2024-11-30"]),
    ("10.0.0.1 2024-11-31", []),
    ("10.0.0.1 2024-03-31", ["2024-03-31"]),
    ("10.0.0.1 2024-05-31", ["2024-05-31"]),
    ("10.0.0.1 2024-07-31", ["2024-07-31"]),
    ("10.0.0.1 2024-08-31", ["2024-08-31"]),
    # CRLF line ending
    ("10.0.0.1 2024-01-15\r", ["2024-01-15"]),
    # tab separator
    ("10.0.0.1\t2024-01-15", ["2024-01-15"]),
    # only one of many similar
    ("2024-01-15 2024-01-16 2024-01-17 10.0.0.1", ["2024-01-17"]),  # ip AFTER last date
]

expected = []
for line, exp in cases:
    expected.extend(exp)

log_text = "\n".join(c[0] for c in cases)
matches = re.findall(pattern, log_text, re.MULTILINE)
ok = True
if matches != expected:
    ok = False
    print("MISMATCH")
    for (line, exp) in cases:
        got = re.findall(pattern, line, re.MULTILINE)
        if got != exp:
            print(f"FAIL | {line!r:50} expected={exp} got={got}")
else:
    print("ALL PASS (%d matches)" % len(matches))

# CRLF in multiline text
t = "10.0.0.1 2024-01-15\r\n2024-06-06 1.1.1.1\r\n"
m = re.findall(pattern, t, re.MULTILINE)
print("CRLF test:", m, "ok" if m == ["2024-01-15","2024-06-06"] else "FAIL")
if m != ["2024-01-15","2024-06-06"]: ok = False

# performance: long lines
big_line = "junk " * 500 + "10.0.0.1 " + "junk " * 500 + "2024-01-15 " + "junk "*500
t0 = time.time()
m = re.findall(pattern, big_line, re.MULTILINE)
dt = time.time() - t0
print("perf single long line: %0.4fs -> %s" % (dt, m))
big = (big_line + "\n") * 2000
t0 = time.time()
m = re.findall(pattern, big, re.MULTILINE)
dt = time.time() - t0
print("perf 2000 long lines: %0.3fs, %d matches" % (dt, len(m)))
print("RESULT:", "OK" if ok else "FAIL")
EOF
